dct_description_sm: The transportation infrastructure is essential for the social and economic development of northern regions. Permafrost degradation, exacerbated by global warming, is threatening the structural and functional integrity of roads and airstrips. Improved methods are required to design, build and maintain these facilities considering the effect of detrimental factors such as snow and water.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Transportation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Adaptation of transportation infrastructure on thaw sensitive permafrost
